versions.description: Initial protocol version with unified question format and multi-agent conversation schemas

validation.runtime_validation: validate.ts CLI called by Python via subprocess

notes: Unified question format supporting BBQ, DiscrimEval, and DifferenceAwareness benchmarks
Flexible agent configuration with role, persona, demographics, and if_as_human attributes
Round-based conversation structure with configurable routing strategies
Zod schemas (schemas.ts) as single source of truth for validation
TypeScript types automatically inferred from Zod schemas
Runtime validation via validate.ts CLI (called by Python)

documentation.overview: This registry tracks all protocol versions for the multi-agent conversation fairness evaluation framework
documentation.versioning_policy: New versions are created when schemas have breaking changes or significant additions
documentation.backward_compatibility: Older transcripts remain valid and parseable with their specified protocol_version
documentation.validation_workflow: Python → subprocess → validate.ts → schemas.ts (Zod) → validation result
